text: Grief is the price we pay for love.
author: Queen Elizabeth II
source: The Servant Queen and the King She Serves

text: The cure for a broken heart is self-love.
author: Jonathan Harnisch

text: A relationship, I think, is like a shark. It has to constantly move forward or it dies. And I think what we got on our hands is a dead shark.
author: Alvy Singer

text: The best way to mend a broken heart is time and girlfriends.
author: Gwyneth Paltrow

text: Like some wines our love could neither mature nor travel.
author: Graham Greene

text: The heart will break, but broken live on.
author: Lord Byron

text: Stuart needs 'space' and 'time,' as if this were physics and not a human relationship.
author: Kathryn Stockett

text: A girl doesn't need anyone who doesn't need her.
author: Marilyn Monroe

text: We are never ever, ever getting back together.
author: Taylor Swift

text: Every time your heart is broken, a doorway cracks open to a world full of new beginnings, new opportunities.
author: Patti Roberts

text: 'Tis better to have loved and lost than never to have loved at all.
author: Alfred Lord Tennyson

text: When you are in love, and you get hurt, it's like a cut—it will heal, but there will always be a scar.
author: Soo Jie

text: I'm really a very happy, contented little person in spite of my broken heart.
author: L.M. Montgomery

text: I know my heart will never be the same. But I'm telling myself I'll be okay.
author: Sara Evans

text: You will need to allow your mind to take it all in so that by the time you get back up on your feet, you know how you feel.
author: Lauren Conrad

text: It's so empowering to say, 'This isn't serving me,' and walk away in peace.
author: Unknown

text: You can clutch the past so tightly to your chest that it leaves your arms too full to embrace the present.
author: Jan Glidewell

text: We too, like trees can shake off our dead leaves and begin again.
author: A.Y. Greyson

text: You get through it. It's a process that's not easy, but I get less and less sad about it every day.
author: Ryan Phillippe

text: But every time you hurt me, the less that I cry. And every time you leave me, the quicker these tears dry. And every time you walk out, the less I love you. Baby, we don't stand a chance, it's sad but it's true.
author: Sam Smith

text: Holding on is believing that there's a past; letting go is knowing that there's a future.
author: Daphne Rose Kingma

text: I know that I love being able to give my love out to someone. I know there is somebody great out there for me.
author: Jennifer Love Hewitt

text: Just believe that the heartbreak was a gift in itself. Cry if you have to, but it won't be forever! You will find love again, and it will be even more beautiful! In the meantime enjoy all that YOU are!
author: Rihanna

text: You cannot prevent the birds of sorrow from flying over your head, but you can prevent them from building nests in your hair.
author: Chinese Proverb

text: You thought that I'd be weak without ya, but I'm stronger. You thought that I'd be broke without ya, but I'm richer. You thought that I'd be sad without ya, I love harder.
author: Destiny's Child

text: The greatest win is walking away and choosing not to engage in drama and toxic energy at all.
author: Lalah Delia

text: I am beginning to feel like the only way to truly get over someone that you cared a lot about is to start a new chapter.
author: Mindy

text: Every time you thought you couldn't keep moving forward, you did. Take a moment to appreciate your strength.
author: Karen Salmanson

text: I was so scared of ever being alone, and I think, conquering that fear, this year, was actually bigger than any other transition that I had, this entire year.
author: Miley Cyrus

text: If you truly want to be respected by people you love, you must prove to them that you can survive without them.
author: Michael Bassey Johnson

text: Every woman that finally figured out her worth, has picked up her suitcases of pride and boarded a flight to freedom, which landed in the valley of change.
author: Shannon L. Alder

text: The truth is, unless you let go, unless you forgive yourself, unless you forgive the situation, unless you realize that the situation is over, you cannot move forward.
author: Steve Maraboli

text: When I let go of what I am, I become what I might be. When I let go of what I have, I receive what I need.
author: Lao Tzu

text: Moving on is not forgetting — moving on is being able to remember without feeling awful about it.
author: Sam Madison

text: Sadness flies away on the wings of time.
author: Jean de La Fontaine

text: That's all you can do in this world, no matter how strong the current beats against you, or how heavy your burden, or how tragic your love story. You keep going.
author: Robyn Schneider

text: You have to love. You have to feel. It is the reason you are here on earth. You are here to risk your heart. You are here to be swallowed up. And when it happens that you are broken, or betrayed, or left, or hurt, or death brushes near, let yourself sit by an apple tree and listen to the apples falling all around you in heaps, wasting their sweetness. Tell yourself you tasted as many as you could.
author: Louise Erdrich

text: You can't move things by not moving.
author: Suzy Kassem

text: You can't start the next chapter of your life if you keep re-reading the last one.
author: Michael McMillian

text: A very wise man once told me that you can't look back – you just have to put the past behind you, and find something better in your future.
author: Jodi Picoult

text: Always forgive your enemies; nothing annoys them so much.
author: Oscar Wilde

text: We accept the love we think we deserve.
author: Stephen Chbosky
source: The Perks of Being a Wallflower

text: It is better to be hated for what you are than to be loved for what you are not.
author: Andre Gide

text: It is not a lack of love, but a lack of friendship that makes unhappy marriages.
author: Friedrich Nietzsche

text: Have you ever been in love? Horrible isn't it? It makes you so vulnerable. It opens your chest and it opens up your heart and it means that someone can get inside you and mess you up.
author: Neil Gaiman
source: The Sandman, Vol. 9: The Kindly Ones

text: I spent so long trying to understand what I felt for you. Now I understand — and understanding is the first step toward letting go.
author: Violet

text: There are feelings that no words can capture. Grief is one of them. But the act of writing them down — even imperfectly — is what heals you.
author: Violet

text: I lost the person who made the world make sense. But slowly, I'm learning to make sense of it without them.
author: Tomoya Okazaki

text: The pain doesn't disappear. It just changes shape. One day you realize it's not a wound anymore — it's proof that you loved.
author: Kousei Arima

text: I've died a hundred times in loops no one else remembers. The one thing that survives every reset is the memory of what I lost. That's what grief really is — the thing that refuses to be erased.
author: Subaru Natsuki

text: I have lived for centuries and loved no one. And yet here I am, still carrying the shape of every goodbye like a scar I chose not to let heal.
author: C.C.

text: Some people leave a hole in your life when they go. The trick is learning that the hole doesn't have to stay empty forever.
author: Ace

text: Everyone I've ever lost taught me something. The ones who broke my heart taught me the most.
author: Luffy

text: I erased you from my memory because the pain of keeping you was too much. But the heart remembers what the mind refuses to.
author: Joel Barish
source: Eternal Sunshine of the Spotless Mind (2004)

text: Even after they take everything — even after they erase you — love leaves its fingerprints on you. You can't wash them off.
author: Clementine Kruczynski
source: Eternal Sunshine of the Spotless Mind (2004)

text: I spent 500 days loving you. And then I spent the rest of my life learning that summer doesn't last — but spring always comes back.
author: Tom Hansen

text: You have to be willing to be a little bit broken to find out what you're made of on the other side.
author: Pat Solitano

text: Everyone thinks I'm the tough one. But I'm the one who cried in the bathroom for three weeks after it ended. Strength isn't not feeling it. It's feeling it and still getting up.
author: Tiffany Maxwell

text: I went to Italy to eat. I went to India to pray. I went to Bali to find balance. And somewhere along the way, I found myself again.
author: Liz Gilbert

text: The ocean doesn't care about the ship that sank on it. It just keeps moving. Be the ocean.
author: Lee

text: Marriage doesn't end with a bang. It ends with two people who stopped reaching for each other.
author: Nicole

text: Someone once asked me how I move on. The honest answer is: I don't. I just learn to carry it differently.
author: Adele

text: The saddest thing in the world is loving someone who used to love you.
author: Taylor Swift

text: I wrote this song because I was angry. Then I listened to it back and realized I wasn't angry anymore. I was just sad. And sad is survivable.
author: Beyoncé

text: I used to think my heart was a locked door. Then I realized it was a revolving one.
author: Olivia Rodrigo

text: Love is a losing game. I won it, I lost it. Either way, I played.
author: Ed Sheeran

text: The chain is broken now. But the links are still there — they just don't bind you anymore.
author: Fleetwood Mac

text: You oughta know what a fool I've been. But it doesn't matter — I'm wiser now, and that's worth every bruise.
author: Alanis Morissette

text: Stay, and I will stay forever. Leave, and I will learn to be whole without you. Either way, I will not break.
author: Sam Smith

text: The wound is the place where the light enters you. Don't be afraid of your broken places — they're where the healing starts.
author: Paulo Coelho

text: There is no greater sorrow than to recall in misery the time when we were happy.
author: Maya Angelou

text: Vulnerability is the birthplace of connection, but it's also the birthplace of shame. The trick is choosing connection anyway.
author: Brene Brown

text: I learned to forgive not because what happened was okay, but because holding on was destroying me.
author: Elizabeth Gilbert

text: Pain has a purpose. It tells you where you are. And sometimes, it tells you where you need to go.
author: C.S. Lewis

text: Your pain is the breaking of the shell that encloses your understanding.
author: Khalil Gibran

text: When one door of happiness closes, another opens; but often we look so long at the closed door that we do not see the one which opens.
author: Helen Keller

text: If you love someone, set them free. If they come back, they're yours. If they don't, they never were.
author: Antoine de Saint-Exupery

text: The hardest thing about walking away is not looking back. The second hardest is admitting you were never really happy.
author: Adele

text: Heartbreak is a rite of passage. You don't graduate from love without it.
author: Olivia Rodrigo

text: I'm not running from you. I'm running toward the version of myself that doesn't need you to feel whole.
author: Beyoncé

text: After the storm, there is always a moment — just one — where the air is so clean and quiet that you remember what it feels like to breathe.
author: Paulo Coelho

text: I have been broken before. And I have learned that broken things can be mended — not into what they were, but into something more honest.
author: Maya Angelou

text: The bravest thing a person can do is feel the pain fully and still choose to love again.
author: Brene Brown

text: You will heal. Not today, maybe not tomorrow. But one morning you will wake up and the ache will be quiet instead of loud.
author: Ed Sheeran

text: Don't measure your healing by how fast it happens. Measure it by how honest it is.
author: Elizabeth Gilbert

text: The people who break your heart are the ones who prove it was real. And real is always worth it.
author: C.S. Lewis

text: I cried for weeks. Then one day I realized the tears weren't just about grief — they were about gratitude. I was grateful I had something worth crying over.
author: Fleetwood Mac

text: You don't get to decide if someone was worth loving. You only get to decide if you're worth loving yourself.
author: Taylor Swift

text: Every ending is a beginning in disguise. The trick is staying awake long enough to see it.
author: Rumi

text: Forgiveness doesn't mean you forget. It means you stop letting the memory run the show.
author: Khalil Gibran

text: You were my whole world for a while. Now you're a chapter. And chapters end so the story can keep going.
author: Alanis Morissette

text: Letting go doesn't mean it didn't matter. It means it mattered so much that you had to choose yourself to survive it.
author: Helen Keller

text: I thought I would never stop missing you. And maybe I won't. But I've stopped letting the missing keep me from living.
author: Antoine de Saint-Exupery

text: The bravest thing I ever did wasn't falling in love. It was standing up after I fell apart.
author: Adele

text: You are not defined by the people who left. You are defined by the way you rebuilt yourself after they did.
author: Maya Angelou

text: I used to think closure was something someone else gives you. Now I know it's something you build, brick by brick, out of the rubble.
author: Brene Brown

text: Grief doesn't follow a schedule. But hope does — it shows up on the days you least expect it, like a song you forgot you loved.
author: Ed Sheeran

text: The most powerful thing you can say to the person who broke you is: I became someone extraordinary because of the pieces you left behind.
author: Olivia Rodrigo

text: Time heals — but only if you let yourself feel the wound first. Don't skip the hard part.
author: C.S. Lewis

text: You will love again. Not the same way. Not the same person. But deeper, truer, and with the full knowledge of how precious it is to be loved at all.
author: Paulo Coelho
